name: Xanthan gum
aliases: E415, xanthan gum, xanthan, goma xantana, goma xanthana, gomme xanthane
what_is: A high molecular weight polysaccharide produced by fermenting glucose or sucrose with Xanthomonas campestris bacteria.
why_botia: It flags it because it is an industrial stabilizer and thickener exclusively used in ultra-processed formulations to modify texture.
can_1: Identify E415 or Xanthan Gum on the label.
can_2: Trigger the texture and E-number information layers.
cannot_1: Identify the carbohydrate substrate used for the bacterial fermentation.
cannot_2: Verify if any trace of the viable Xanthomonas campestris production strain remains in the final additive powder.
